title: Jeweled Juicy Filipino Coconut Ginataang Bilo Bilo
description: A peppery, silky, comforting Filipino dish featuring star anise and a nimono-simmer, this vegan-friendly ginataang bilo bilo is a delicious treat. It is made with coconut milk and various fruits and tubers.
instructions: In a large pot, combine the coconut milk, star anise, and salt, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to medium low and simmer for 10 minutes, or until the mixture has reduced slightly.
Add the jackfruit, taro, and sweet potato to the pot, and continue to simmer for 15 minutes, or until the tubers are tender.
Add the saba banana to the pot and simmer for an additional 5 minutes, or until the banana is cooked through.
Stir in the palawan honey and black pepper until well combined.
Remove the pot from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Serve the ginataang bilo bilo warm, garnished with additional star anise if desired.
